fullName: Centre for Research on Governance and Development
motto: Independent Research. Informed Dialogue. Transformative Policy.
visionShort: To advance a responsible society where liberty, democracy, and prosperity are sustained by independent thought, robust scholarship, accountable institutions, and evidence-based public policy that delivers meaningful and lasting change.
